text:
Aisha (People Ops): Hey team — thinking about running a small 'Peer Pantry' pop-up + sticker-station next month as a low-effort recognition touchpoint for offices and remote folks. Need to lock dates, budget, and the tax/award plumbing. Thoughts?
Ravi (People Ops): love it. Are we pairing with spot awards (small $ awards) or just physical swag/stickers/snacks?
Aisha (People Ops): Both ideally — quick on-site sticker station and a digital spot-award option (gift cards) for remote. Budget per office ~$350.
Jordan (Facilities): We can reserve a lobby table for 3 hours on Thu 3/14 and Mon 3/18. Which one works?
Emily (Eng): 3/14 works for our team demo day — more foot traffic.
Alex (Eng): SGTM. Can we have a QR for remote folks to nominate someone and trigger a digital card?
Ravi (People Ops): Yes — plan: in-person sticker station + QR leading to short nom form -> approval flow -> kudos-bot issues gift card.
kudos-bot: Reminder: workflows must include manager approval before issuance.
Marta (Payroll): Heads up: any cash/gift cards over $100 need to be reported as taxable income in most jurisdictions. Under $100 may still be taxable depending on country — we should include a short tax note to recipients.
Liam (Finance): We can categorize these as "Employee Recognition" expense; please collect names and shipping addresses separately for non-gift-card items. For gift cards, we need org code and approver for expense capture.
Aisha (People Ops): Ok — action items: 1) pick date 2) create sign-up/nom form 3) prepare tax blurb + FAQ 4) procurement & shipping plan 5) design sticker sheet and signage. Who takes which?
Ravi (People Ops): I can own the sign-up form & signage. Will mock a Google Form and short landing copy.
Marta (Payroll): I'll draft a 2-line tax blurb we can paste where recipients redeem. Also will confirm which thresholds apply for remote countries we support.
Jordan (Facilities): I'll lock 3/14 for SF lobby and ask vendor to deliver table + two chairs. Remote packing: I can create a packing checklist for remote kit shipments.
Liam (Finance): I'll send the org code and approval matrix. Also confirm monthly spend cap per office — propose $350 as Aisha suggested.
Alex (Eng): I'll wire up a tiny redemption page and QR -> form -> Slack webhook for kudos-bot to pick up. ETA: one week.
Emily (Eng): Happy to help with sticker art and packing labels.
Ravi (People Ops): Cool. One subtle policy point — for managers approving awards, can we require sign-off only from direct manager (no skip-level)? Marta, is that fine for payroll tracking?
Marta (Payroll): Direct manager sign-off is easiest for us. If a non-manager needs to approve, flag it and we'll do an exception review.
Aisha (People Ops): Great. I'll draft the event brief and timeline. Proposed internal deadline: marketing assets & badges by 3/1, sign-up live 3/4, ship remote kits 3/10.
Liam (Finance): Approved provisional budget. Please cc me on expense pre-approval messages.
Jordan (Facilities): Noted. If we end up doing multiple offices, we'll stagger dates — start SF 3/14.
Ravi (People Ops): Link to the live planning doc (will fill today): https://docs.google.com/whatever (placeholder)
Alex (Eng): quick question about the workflow: kudos-bot should attach a small note at redemption that reads: "This award may be taxable — see FAQ". OK?
Marta (Payroll): Yes, include exactly that line and link to the FAQ. I will upload a one-pager.
Emily (Eng): Also suggest a small QR on sticker packaging that points to a digital 'thank you' card for remote folks — keeps the experience consistent.
Aisha (People Ops): Love it. Final call: 3/14 SF pop-up, $350 per office pilot, sign-up live 3/4. If no objections by EOD, I'll publish the brief and tag owners.
Alex (Eng): No objections from me.
Emily (Eng): 👍
Jordan (Facilities): 👍
Liam (Finance): 👍
Marta (Payroll): 👍 will post tax blurb by tomorrow.
Ravi (People Ops): I'll take the post and RSVP tracker. Thanks all! :sparkles:
